items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the name of the principal of the school was Jim Crow!

ctx.x: Because when I started to really flow with jazz, I got kicked out of high school and there was a funny story. I was late for class and we had a canteen and you know I was coming in late for class and the name of the principal of the school was Jim Crow! [laughs]
